metadata.description: Agent Skills for working with Skardi, an open-source self-improving context framework. Teaches AI coding agents Skardi's patterns for building searchable context, hybrid search, graph queries, connectors, and reusing the queries that already worked instead of rewriting them.

plugins.name: skardi
plugins.description: Build searchable context over documents or your own datastore, answer questions from live data, query a property graph through SQL, read cached documents by section, keep a working memory of a task that another agent can pick up, and reuse the queries that already worked instead of rewriting them. Bundles the auto-context, retrieval, graph-source, graph-rag, document-cache, memory, and skardi-query-log skills.
